messages:
Marta (CSM): FYI — CardinalCare QBR next Wed 11am ET. Need: final slide deck, 1-page exec asks, demo owner, and a short risk register. Can we assign owners today?
Ethan (Lead CSM): I can take the risk register + renewal ask slide.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll own the demo and the technical health slide (error rates, avg latency, recent deploys). Need a stable sandbox from Eng.
Pri (Enablement): I'll do enablement impact (training completion %, active users) and own the rehearsal. What time for dry-run?
Marta (CSM): Dry-run Mon 4pm ET? Pri, can you send invite with checklist?
Pri (Enablement): Yep sending now. Will also include a 5-min Q&A prep doc for execs.
Zoe (AE): Request: include commercial asks on the one-pager: expansion targets + renewal cadence. Ethan, can we sync for 10?
Ethan (Lead CSM): On it. 10 after this thread.
Clara (RevOps): Quick note: if you surface renewal pressure, I need the contract end date and current ARR delta in the sheet. I'll add an escalation template.
Marta (CSM): Owners & deadlines: Ethan -> renewal + risk register (EOD), Omar -> demo + tech slide (tomorrow 10am), Pri -> rehearsal invite + enablement slide (tomorrow 9am), Clara -> ARR snapshot + escalation template (EOD), Zoe -> customer quote / exec touchpoint summary (EOD). I'll draft the 1-pager after these land.
reminder-bot: Reminder created: CardinalCare QBR Wednesday 11:00 ET (channel reminder).
Omar (Solutions Eng): For demo: I'll run the prompt flow that shows latency improvements after quantization. Maya from Eng, can you provision a canary GPU instance?
Marta (CSM): Maya is out today. Omar, can you use the hosted sandbox? If not, flag and we'll escalate to Eng.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Hosted sandbox is fine but I'll need the sample dataset. Sharing expected dataset format in the drive.
Pri (Enablement): Putting rehearsal on calendars Mon 4pm ET. Agenda: 1) 20m run-through, 2) 10m Q&A prep, 3) 5m slide handoff.
Ethan (Lead CSM): Drafted renewal heatmap: usage trend vs exec engagement. Dropping in drive: #drive/shared/qbr/cardinalcare/renewal_heatmap_v0.pptx
Zoe (AE): Pasted a short internal quote from their Onboarding Survey: "Saved ~12 engineering hours/week since rollout" — will add to the deck.
Clara (RevOps): ARR snapshot uploaded to the sheet. Noting two small invoice disputes in Feb (ticket #4521, #4525) 1; if unresolved, mark as moderate risk.
Marta (CSM): Good catch. Ethan, please flag disputes in the risk register.
Ethan (Lead CSM): Marked invoice disputes as 'billing risk' with owner Zoe and RevOps follow-up due by Tue EOD.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Slide notes include this snippet for reliability playbook:
"Fallbacks: degrade to cached embeddings for read-only queries; warm prefix cache during demo; routing: shift to smaller-quant models on high latency spikes."
Marta (CSM): Final ask: keep slides in #drive/shared/qbr/cardinalcare by COB Tue so I can compile the exec one-pager. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
Pri (Enablement): Added rehearsal checklist to the folder.
Marta (CSM): Thanks team 1; will send final one-pager Tue night for last sign-off. End thread unless urgent changes.
